title: 30 分钟多家族策略搜索：入场、过滤、退出与连续持仓验证
purpose: A finite predeclared search of32 executable strategy hypotheses, not a Cartesian parameter sweep. All prices/periods were inspected by prior research. Select once on development base-cost portfolio Sharpe with the existing activity gate, then evaluate every declared candidate without replacement, including failed and inactive families.

selection: Exactly once: highest development BASE-cost daily portfolio Sharpe among all32declared candidates with finite Sharpe and>=30closed trades in EACH of six symbols. Ties follow declared order. Separate >=4profitable symbols and positive median-symbol-meanR qualification does not trigger reselection on failure. Stress is not available on development and cannot influence this selection. No later-window choice or fallback winner; if no eligible candidate stop without inspecting validation. Every candidate is reported thereafter, including ineligible and losing families.
dataPolicy: Reuse official checksum-verified Binance UM trade/mark minute data and actual funding. All2037evaluation days are already known; this is adaptive exploratory research and pseudo-out-of-development diagnosis, never untouchedOOS. Fixed six modern surviving symbols and static precision. Same60000initial split into six10000sleeves for every candidate/window; never sum competing full-capital accounts. No interpolation, date shortening or asset substitution for missing data. July2022/Aug2024 remain missing. Each independent window resets; validation-continuous alone carries positions/cash/funding/risk uninterrupted across760days, with one final end-range settlement. Annual/monthly slices of that account use previous daily equity, not artificial forced closes.

fixedRules.signalPeriod: All32candidates use30-minute completed UTC candles and next executable minute open. Minute data still monitors existing hard stops, costs/funding/guard. No live quote or same-close execution claim.
fixedRules.breakout: Prior N high/low excluding signal candle, at least one tick. Channel exit closes cross prior independent M reverse boundary. Episode first-close state updates even while entry unavailable; returning inside frozen boundary rearms only a later close.
fixedRules.pullback: Existing3bar1.5ATR directional impulse and efficiency>=.6;20%-50%retracement for2..8bars; rebreak whole impulse high/low. Existing implementation uses impulse-confirmation ATR and does not share PA extension deadline/key-level eligibility.
fixedRules.kdj: Existing9/3/3 stochasticKDJ. One K<=20 or K>=80 episode arms, later distinct candle K/D cross triggers; position/risk/filter invalidation consumes eligibility. Unfiltered version is a separate reversal hypothesis, not a claim that oscillators identify trend.
fixedRules.priceAction: Existing forward-only impulse/extension/retracement state machine and whole-advance extreme entry. Four predefined combinations of keyLevel and twoLegs; all preserve background-data warmup even if flags off. No chart pattern inference/lookahead pivots.
fixedRules.filters: none; EMA20/60 alignment+fast3bar slope; price vsEMA60+slow3bar slope; compound2hbackground. These are filter policies, not newMAcrossover-entry implementations.
fixedRules.initialRisk: ATR14Wilder, actual-fill stop2ATR frozen except declared stop3; shared risk.5%,exposure95%,cooldown3losses60min. dailyLoss3% exceptsingle0. ATRrisk and fees/rounding determine actual quantities.
fixedRules.exits: channel; frozen-signal-ATR minute-MFE trailing3; staged completed-close dynamicATR3 or6; BE0/1R/2R; staged BE1R+trailing-start2R. Dynamic start0 means first closeR>=0 then latched, not unconditional sinceentry. Completed-close proposals apply later; already-crossed proposal requests next-open exit. No fixed takeprofit implemented or inferred.
fixedRules.riskGuard: Each sleeve UTC day-first mark.open equity beforefunding/orders anchor; minute mark.close at<=97%queues nextopen exit and blocks entriesrestofUTCday. dailyLoss0removes both effects, not separately identifying them. BEcost price includesaccruedfunding but not futurefunding/gaps.
fixedRules.warmup: active-windows-v1 peractualcandidate; allperiod30m, max14days. Native16candidate chunks may differ in maximum preload but eachcandidate has itsownsame initialization. No cross-shard state, parameter or selection mixing.
fixedRules.searchScope: 32whole-account hypotheses:20breakout variants including controls alreadyseen,4impulsepullback,4KDJ,4price-action. No post-result extension, unseen-constructor labels, Cartesian threshold grid or retrospective coin weights. Shared exit changes do not claim identical-entry causal matching.

searchEvaluation.method: All32candidate x base/stress64daily account returnseries share circular calendar blocks sampled separately within eachwindow, preserving original213/760daycounts. N=973, dailymeansweightedbydays. Pointwise95%percentile intervals (floorB*.025/floorB*.975) are notsimultaneous. White-inspired least-favorable centered circular-block max-mean diagnostic: cash family x_j=r_j all64; incremental family x_j=r_j-r_baseline_samecost excludesbaseline self (62). mu_j mean; T_j=sqrtN*max(0,mu_j), T_family=maxT_j; Z_b=max(0,max_j sqrtN*(mu*_bj-mu_j)); p=(1+count[Z_b>=T])/(B+1), nonpositive mean p1. No studentization or dropping weak rules. Bothglobal and eachcandidate adjustedp reported, both7/28block lengths fixed. Centring all means atzero isleastfavorable and conservative; windows treatedfixedstrata. NotSPA,DSRorproject-wide correction.
searchEvaluation.acceptance: Historical criteria only, no live/prospective certification. Frozen selected must be developmentqualified; >=180validationdays, >=100closedtrades total and>=10eachsymbol underbothcosts; bothwindows netpositive anddailydrawdown>=-10%underbothcosts; selected absolutelower95CI>0 for7/28blocksandbothcosts; selected cash-family adjustedp<=.05for7/28blocksandbothcosts. Global significance ofanother candidate cannot qualifyselected. Incrementalrelativebaselinep reportedbutnotrequired. Failure=>not-established,no replacement. Passing=>historical-criteria-passedwithknown/adaptivelimits.

limitations: All history and some controls previously inspected;32declaredtrials addto accumulated search. This maxdiagnostic onlyadjusts current32x2family, not priorstagesorhuman hypothesis selection.
Only32 prespecified module recipes, not allpossible strategies. MAfilters are not MAentry; KDJunfiltered isnot failure-breakout. No vol-breakout/MAcrossover/neworder-types/live/paperdeployment claim.
